items.title: Renew Kansas City, Kansas occupation tax license
items.authority: Unified Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, Kansas, Business License Division
items.description: Businesses and services in Kansas City, Kansas need an occupation tax license; the licensing year runs January 1 to December 31, and a zoning application comes first for physical locations.
items.deadlineNote: renewal period opens December 1; delinquent penalties begin March 1

note: The City Clerk says the city does not require a general business license; liquor, massage, pawnbroker, payday-loan, taxi and tow businesses are licensed.
City testimony to the Kansas Senate states the city has no general business license and uses specific occupational licenses (massage, pawn, scrap metal, payday lenders, taxis and others).
The City Clerk says the city does not issue general business licenses; specific regulated activities require a license or occupation tax.
The city does not require a standard business license for all businesses, only for certain activities listed on its Business Licenses page.
